name: accessibilityFocus
description: Set or clear the Android TalkBack accessibility-focus cursor on a target element (Android only). Provide one selector: resourceId, text, or contentDesc. action defaults to 'set'; pass 'clear' to clear the cursor.

action.description: Set (default) or clear the accessibility (TalkBack) focus cursor

resourceId.description: Resource ID of the target element, e.g. com.example:id/title

text.description: Text of the target element (resolved to a resource-id via the element finder)

contentDesc.description: Content description of the target element (resolved to a resource-id)

name: biometricAuth
description: Simulate biometric authentication (fingerprint) on Android emulators, or inject a deterministic result via the AutoMobile SDK on any device. Supports match/fail/cancel/error actions. The SDK broadcast path requires the app to integrate AutoMobileBiometrics.consumeOverride().

action.description: Biometric action: 'match' triggers successful authentication, 'fail' simulates a non-matching biometric, 'cancel' cancels the prompt, 'error' injects a hard error (requires AutoMobileBiometrics SDK integration in the app).

modality.description: Biometric modality (default: 'any'). Currently only 'fingerprint' is reliably supported on Android emulators. 'face' is not consistently supported.

fingerprintId.description: Fingerprint ID to simulate (default: 1 for 'match'/'error', 2 for 'fail'/'cancel'). Use enrolled ID (typically 1) for match/error, non-enrolled ID (typically 2) for fail/cancel.

errorCode.description: BiometricPrompt error code to inject (e.g. 7 for ERROR_LOCKOUT, 1 for ERROR_HW_UNAVAILABLE). Only valid when action is 'error'; providing it with any other action is a validation error.

ttlMs.description: How long the SDK override remains active in milliseconds (default: 5000). The override is cleared after the first authentication callback or when the TTL expires.

name: changeLocalization
description: Change locale, time zone, text direction, time format, and calendar system

calendarSystem.description: Calendar system (e.g., gregory, japanese, buddhist, islamic-civil)

restartApp.description: Bundle ID of app to terminate and relaunch after locale change (iOS only). Running apps cache locale at launch, so restart is needed for the app to pick up new settings.

name: clearText
description: Clear text from focused input

name: clipboard
description: Clipboard operations (copy/paste/clear/get)

action.description: Clipboard action: copy=set clipboard, paste=paste into focused field, clear=clear clipboard, get=get clipboard content

name: criticalSection
description: Coordinate multiple devices at a synchronization barrier and execute steps serially. All devices must reach the critical section before any can proceed. Steps execute one device at a time in the order they acquire the lock.

lock.description: Global lock identifier. All devices using the same lock name will wait for each other at this barrier.

params.description: Tool-specific parameters. Must include a non-empty 'device'.

steps.description: Steps to execute serially within the critical section. Each step should target a specific device using the 'device' parameter.

deviceCount.description: Number of devices expected to reach this critical section. All devices must arrive before any can proceed.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for waiting at the barrier (default: 30000ms)

name: deviceSnapshot
description: Capture or restore a device snapshot for the active device.

includeAppData.description: Include app data directories in snapshot

useVmSnapshot.description: Use emulator VM snapshot if available (faster, emulator only)

strictBackupMode.description: If true, fail entire snapshot if app data backup fails or times out

backupTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for adb backup user confirmation

userApps.description: Which apps to backup: 'current' (foreground app only) or 'all' (all user-installed apps)

vmSnapshotTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for emulator VM snapshot commands

appBundleIds.description: iOS-only: bundle IDs to include in app data snapshots (omit to skip app data capture)

name: doctor
description: Run diagnostic checks to verify AutoMobile setup and environment configuration

installCmdlineTools.description: Automatically download and install Android SDK Command-line Tools to ANDROID_HOME if missing

installXcodeCommandLineTools.description: Install Xcode Command Line Tools if missing

name: dragAndDrop
description: Drag and drop element

name: executePlan
description: Execute a series of tool calls from a YAML plan content. Stops execution if any step fails (success: false). Optionally can resume execution from a specific step index.

deviceAllocationTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for allocating all devices (default: 300000 = 5 minutes)

cleanupAppId.description: App ID to terminate after execution

captureObserveSteps.description: Single-device plans only: attach each successful observe step snapshot to executePlan result `debug.steps[n].details.stepObservation` (`summary` = metadata + element samples; `full` = includes viewHierarchy). Ignored for multi-device plans.

name: exportPlan
description: Stop the active test recording and export recorded interactions as a YAML plan. Returns the plan content.

recordingId.description: Recording ID to export (uses active recording if not specified)

planName.description: Name for the exported plan (auto-generated if not specified)

name: getAppPermissions
description: Read app permission state on Android devices and iOS simulators

appId.description: App package ID or bundle identifier

permissions.description: Optional permission names or simulator privacy services to query. If omitted, returns known permission rows.

name: getDeepLinks
description: Query deep links for app

name: getDeviceState
description: Read device-level state such as Do Not Disturb

include.description: Optional device state fields to read. Currently supports doNotDisturb.

name: getNotificationPolicy
description: Read app notification policy state, including Android Do Not Disturb policy access

appId.description: App package ID or bundle identifier

name: highlight
description: Draw a visual highlight around a UI element on the device screen for debugging.

elementId.description: Element resource-id (e.g. "com.app:id/btn_login"). Only use for resource-id values.

text.description: Element text, content-desc, or placeholder value from observe output.

container.description: Container selector object to scope search. Provide { "elementId": "<id>" } or { "text": "<text>" }.

containerOf.description: Whether to highlight the container of the selected element

selectionStrategy.description: Element selection strategy when multiple matches are found (default: first)

name: homeScreen
description: Go to home screen

name: imeAction
description: Perform IME action

name: inputText
description: Input text. The optional mode field is Android-only and ignored on iOS.

mode.description: (Android only; ignored on iOS) Text input mode. a11y (default) sets text directly. eventLast sets text with a11y up to the last printable non-whitespace ASCII character, sends that character as a real key event, then restores any suffix with a11y. eventAll clears the field with a11y, sends key events for mappable ASCII characters, and uses a11y for Unicode/emoji runs. Search fields that use autocomplete should probably try eventLast; otherwise accept the default.

dismissKeyboard.description: (Android only) Dismiss soft keyboard after input (default: false). Ignored on iOS.

name: installApp
description: Install app on device (.apk for Android, .app for iOS simulator, .ipa for iOS physical device)

artifactPath.description: Path to app artifact (.apk for Android, .app bundle for iOS simulator, .ipa for iOS physical device)

name: keyboard
description: Open, close, or detect the on-screen keyboard

name: killDevice
description: Kill device

name: launchApp
description: Launch app by package name

clearAppData.description: Clear app data before launch (default false)

name: listApps
description: Guide for listing apps via MCP resources

name: listDeviceImages
description: List device images

name: listDevices
description: List devices (resource guidance)

name: observe
description: Get screen view hierarchy

waitFor.description: Wait for element to appear before returning observation

container.description: Scope the match inside this container. Use when resource IDs repeat (e.g. id/name in a RecyclerView).
Scope the match inside this container. Use when resource IDs repeat (e.g. id/name in a RecyclerView).

raw.description: When true, include unprocessed view hierarchy in response alongside normal output (default: false)

skipBackStack.description: When true, skip back stack collection during waitFor polling to reduce ADB overhead (default: false)

name: openLink
description: Open URL in browser

name: phoneCall
description: Simulate an incoming phone call on an Android emulator via the emulator console (gsm call/accept/cancel/busy/hold). Emulator-only: physical devices return an unsupported error.

action.description: Phone call action: 'call' simulates an incoming call; 'accept' answers a ringing or waiting call; 'cancel' ends the call from the network side; 'busy' rejects a waiting call with a busy signal; 'hold' puts the active call on hold (no phoneNumber required).

phoneNumber.description: Phone number for the call action. Required for all actions except 'hold'. Digits with optional leading '+', max 20 digits.

name: pinchOn
description: Pinch to zoom

includeSystemInsets.description: Use full screen including status/nav bars

container.description: Container selector object to scope search. Provide { "elementId": "<id>" } or { "text": "<text>" }.

name: postNotification
description: Post a notification from the app-under-test when AutoMobile SDK hooks are installed.

imagePath.description: Host image file path to push to /sdcard/Download/automobile when imageType is bigPicture

name: pressButton
description: Press device or navigation button

name: recentApps
description: Open recent apps

name: recordSteps
description: Record MCP tool calls as a replayable YAML test plan. Actions: 'begin' starts capturing plan-relevant tool calls, 'end' stops and exports the plan as YAML (both require the 'mcp-recording' feature flag), 'status' checks if a recording session is active (always available, even when the flag is off).

action.description: begin: start capturing tool calls. end: stop and export the recorded plan as YAML. status: check if a recording session is active.

planName.description: Name for the exported plan (kebab-case recommended, auto-generated if not specified). Only used with action 'end'.

name: rotate
description: Rotate device orientation

name: selectAllText
description: Select all text in focused input

name: sendSms
description: Send a simulated incoming SMS to an Android emulator via the emulator console (sms send). Emulator-only: physical devices return an unsupported error.

phoneNumber.description: Sender phone number for the simulated incoming SMS. Digits with optional leading '+', max 20 digits.

message.description: SMS message body. Max 1024 characters. Must not contain newlines, carriage returns, or NUL bytes.

name: setActiveDevice
description: Set active device

name: setAppPermissions
description: Grant, revoke, reset, or configure app permissions on Android devices and iOS simulators

appId.description: App package ID or bundle identifier

action.description: Permission action. Defaults to grant. Android runtime permissions currently support grant only; iOS simulators support grant/revoke/reset.

permissions.description: Runtime permissions or simulator privacy services to change

userId.description: Android user id for runtime permission grants

notificationPolicyAccess.description: Android only: set notification policy / DND access

scheduleExactAlarm.description: Android only: set UID-level SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM appop

name: setDeviceState
description: Set device-level state such as Do Not Disturb

doNotDisturb.description: Do Not Disturb state to apply.

enabled.description: Enable or disable Do Not Disturb. If true without mode, uses the strictest available DND mode.

mode.description: Do Not Disturb mode: off, none/total silence, priority, or alarms.

name: setNotificationPolicy
description: Set app notification policy state, including Android Do Not Disturb policy access

appId.description: App package ID or bundle identifier

policyAccess.description: Android only: allow or revoke app notification policy / DND access

name: shake
description: Shake device

name: startDevice
description: Start device

name: startTestRecording
description: Start test recording mode on the active device. Records user interactions for later export as a test plan. Returns the session ID which can be used with exportPlan.

name: swipeOn
description: Swipe/scroll on screen or elements

includeSystemInsets.description: Use full screen including status/nav bars

container.description: Container selector object to scope search. Provide { "elementId": "<id>" } or { "text": "<text>" }.

gestureType.description: swipeFingerTowardsDirection: finger moves in direction (e.g., 'up' = finger up = content scrolls down). scrollTowardsDirection: content moves in direction (e.g., 'up' = content up = see content below). Default: scrollTowardsDirection.

lookFor.description: Element to look for during swipe

elementId.description: ID of the element to look for

boomerang.description: Return to start position after swipe apex

apexPause.description: Pause duration at swipe apex in ms (0-3000)

name: systemTray
description: System tray actions for notifications (open/close/find/tap/dismiss/clearAll)

action.description: Action: open=expand tray, close=collapse tray/shade, find=search for notification, tap=tap notification, dismiss=swipe away, clearAll=dismiss all for app

tapActionLabel.description: Action button label to tap (for 'tap' action)

awaitTimeout.description: Timeout in ms to wait for notification (default: 5000)

name: tapAny
description: Tap any clickable element without knowing its text or ID. Good for tapping the first list item. Use container to scope, selectionStrategy to pick 'first' (default) or 'random', and scrollableContainer: true to limit to list/RecyclerView items.

container.description: Container selector object to scope search. Provide { "elementId": "<id>" } or { "text": "<text>" }.

scrollableContainer.description: Only search within scrollable containers (lists/RecyclerViews). Use this to avoid tapping search bars or other clickable UI elements when you want the first list item.

searchUntil.description: Poll for clickable element before tapping

name: tapOn
description:
Tap a specific UI element identified by text or resource-id.
Provide a selector: { "text": "Login" } or { "elementId": "com.app:id/btn" }.
Set sibling: true to tap a clickable sibling adjacent to the matched element (e.g., a checkbox next to a label).
content-desc values from observe should be passed as text, not elementId.

elementId.description: Element resource-id (e.g. "com.app:id/btn_login"). Only use for resource-id values.

text.description: Element text, content-desc, or placeholder value from observe output.

selector.description: Element to tap. Provide exactly one of elementId or text.

sibling.description: When true, tap a clickable sibling of the matched element instead of the element itself. Useful for tapping checkboxes, icons, or buttons adjacent to a text label.

container.description: Container selector object to scope search. Provide { "elementId": "<id>" } or { "text": "<text>" }.

selectionStrategy.description: Element selection strategy when multiple matches are found (default: first)

preTapStability.description: When true, refresh the accessibility hierarchy before tapping and require consecutive re-finds with stable bounds before dispatching the gesture. Prevents tapping stale coordinates when the UI is still settling (loading overlays, list refreshes, keyboard). Recommended for search result lists and dynamic content.

retryIfNoChange.description: When true, compare the view hierarchy before and after the tap. If unchanged (ghost tap detected), retry the tap once after a short delay. Recommended for taps that should cause obvious UI changes like navigation or screen transitions.

ensureTap.description: Convenience flag that enables both preTapStability and retryIfNoChange. Use on taps in dynamic UI where you want both stable bounds before tapping and ghost-tap detection after.

name: terminateApp
description: Terminate app by package name

name: uninstallApp
description: Uninstall app by package name or bundle identifier

appId.description: App package ID or bundle identifier to uninstall

keepData.description: Keep app data after uninstall (Android only, default false)

name: videoRecording
description: Start or stop a low-overhead video recording for the active device.

maxDuration.description: Max seconds to record video for (default 30, max 300)

outputName.description: Optional label to identify the recording

highlights.description: Optional highlights to show during recording
